summary: Repair runtime dependencies and retain strict image gates with expiring reviewed exceptions
details: USDB bundled SQLite excludes unused FTS5, and compatible dependency updates remove the reviewed RustSec vulnerabilities from the USDB workspace and the unchanged Ord 0.23.3 source build.
USDB services and Ord use fixed dependency lockfiles and cargo-auditable metadata; final-image scans must identify dependency inventories for all five shipped Rust binaries.
Debian runtime images use the reviewed base digest; local node_modules, dist and Python caches are excluded from Docker contexts to prevent shipping development executables and stale outputs.
The reviewed Debian High/Critical exceptions expire on 2026-10-07 UTC and apply only to formal testnet tags, exact package versions, linux/amd64, and reviewed build/runtime source fingerprints.

New or unclassified findings, changed applicability, available package fixes, missing scan coverage, expired exceptions, and invalid evidence still block strict releases. Mainnet does not inherit these exceptions.
Complete JSON and SARIF findings are retained together with the exception catalog, per-finding decisions, hashes, and raw versus unresolved counts.
Checkpoint recovery tests isolate injected faults per task to prevent interference with parallel installation tests.
